<meta name="theme-color" content="#080b0a">
<meta name="description" content="Footprint Map 产品发布：从一颗黄星开始，将地图、照片、视频、旅行攻略与路线连接起来。">
<title>Footprint Map · 产品发布</title>
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml;base64," type="image/svg+xml">
<style>
:root{--black:#080a09;--panel:#111715;--panel2:#161e1b;--white:#f4f2eb;--quiet:#a6ada6;--muted:#7a857e;--line:rgba(238,242,235,.115);--green:#9eafa0;--forest:#1f3932;--star:#d5a544;--radius:22px;--ease:cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth}body{margin:0;background:var(--black);color:var(--white);font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"PingFang SC","Noto Sans CJK SC",Arial,sans-serif;font-size:15px;line-height:1.65;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}button,a{-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer}img{max-width:100%;display:block}::selection{background:#7b9484;color:#080b09}.ambient{pointer-events:none;position:fixed;z-index:-1;filter:blur(15px)}.ambient-a{width:65vw;height:70vh;top:-25vh;right:-20vw;background:radial-gradient(circle,#1c3b3080 0%,transparent 67%)}.ambient-b{width:40vw;height:70vh;bottom:-45vh;left:-25vw;background:radial-gradient(circle,#1c38307a,transparent 65%)}
.site{min-height:100vh;min-height:100dvh;display:flex;flex-direction:column}.header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:20;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;height:92px;padding:0 clamp(20px,5.2vw,88px);background:rgba(8,10,9,.87);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);backdrop-filter:blur(18px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px)}.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-width:0}.brand img{width:165px;height:56px;object-fit:contain}.brand-suffix{color:#9da99f;font-size:11px;white-space:nowrap;border-left:1px solid #526156;padding-left:13px;letter-spacing:.13em}.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:clamp(9px,1.7vw,24px);height:100%}.nav button{border:0;background:none;color:var(--muted);padding:20px 1px;font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap;letter-spacing:.065em;position:relative;transition:color .25s}.nav button:hover,.nav button.active{color:var(--white)}.nav button.active:after{position:absolute;content:'';bottom:14px;left:0;width:100%;height:1px;background:var(--green)}#nav-toggle{display:none;border:0;background:transparent;padding:13px;width:46px;height:44px;place-items:center}#nav-toggle span{display:block;background:#e7e8e0;width:22px;height:1px;margin:5px auto}
#page-root{flex:1;position:relative}.page{display:none;animation:reveal .48s var(--ease) both;max-width:1440px;width:100%;margin:0 auto;padding:58px clamp(22px,5.2vw,88px) 80px}.page.active{display:block}@keyframes reveal{from{opacity:.3;transform:translateY(13px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
.hero-page{position:relative;min-height:calc(100vh - 155px);min-height:calc(100dvh - 155px);display:none;grid-template-columns:1.05fr em{font-style:normal;color:#aebfb0}.hero-desc{color:#cacfc6;font-size:clamp(16px,1.8vw,22px);line-height:1.9;letter-spacing:.03em;margin:0 0 .origin-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px}.origin-card{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#111613;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden}.origin-image{height:clamp(270px,30vw,410px);overflow:hidden;background:#111714;display:grid;place-items:center}.origin-image img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;filter:saturate(.85);transition:transform 1s var(--ease)}.origin-card:hover img{transform:scale(1.05)}.origin-caption{padding:23px 25px 28px;min-height:177px}.mini-index{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.15em;color:#96b39d;font-weight:700}.origin-caption h3{font-size:21px;margin:9px 0 8px}.origin-caption p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.9;color:#a4afa5;margin:0}.statement{margin-top:34px;padding:27px 34px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:22px;border-top:1px solid #425649;border-bottom:1px solid #253a2d}.statement-star{font-size:27px;color:var(--star)}.statement p{font-size:clamp(18px,2.6vw,30px);letter-spacing:-.03em;margin:0}

.content-showcase{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.25fr 1fr;gap:18px;min-height:560px}.shot-main,.shot-minor{background:#121916;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:25px;position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;overflow:hidden;padding:14px}.shot-main img{width:100%;height:530px;object-fit:contain}.shot-stack{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px}.shot-minor img{width:100%;height:530px;object-fit:contain}.shot-label{position:absolute;left:20px;bottom:17px;font-size:11px;color:#d9e4d9;background:#0b100eda;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid #ffffff15;border-radius:30px}.content-process{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;border-top:1px solid #405345;border-bottom:1px solid #405345;padding:27px 0;margin:31px 0 65px}.content-process div{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap}.content-process div span{font-size:10px;color:#8ca48b}.content-process i{height:1px;background:#445748;flex:1}.external-demo{border-radius:28px;background:#131a16;padding:40px;border:1px solid var(--line)}.external-heading{display:flex;align-items:start;justify-content:space-between;gap:30px}.external-heading h3{font-size:30px;margin:0}.external-heading p{font-size:13px;color:#a6b3a8;line-height:1.8;max-width:410px;margin:0}.external-gallery{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;margin-top:25px}.external-gallery>div{min-width:0;border-radius:18px;border:1px solid #ffffff0e;background:#0b100d;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;padding:18px}.external-gallery img{height:410px;max-width:100%;object-fit:contain;border-radius:13px}.external-gallery span{font-size:11px;color:#adbdaf;margin-top:15px}

<body>
<div class="ambient ambient-a" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="ambient ambient-b" aria-hidden="true"></div>
<div class="site">
  <header class="header">
    <a class="brand" href="#/home" aria-label="Footprint Map 首页"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Footprint Map 原版手写 Logo"/><span class="brand-suffix">产品发布</span></a>
    <nav class="nav" aria-label="章节导航">
      <button type="button" data-nav="home">概览</button>
      <button type="button" data-nav="origin">缘起</button>
      <button type="button" data-nav="map">地图与图标</button>
      <button type="button" data-nav="system">视觉细节</button>
      <button type="button" data-nav="content">地点内容</button>
      <button type="button" data-nav="route">路线与出发</button>
    </nav>
    <button id="nav-toggle" aria-label="打开章节菜单" aria-expanded="false"><span></span><span></span></button>
  </header>

  <main id="page-root">
    <section class="page hero-page" data-page="home" aria-labelledby="hero-title">
      <div class="hero-copy">
        <div class="eyebrow"><span class="eyebrow-line"></span> Footprint Map / 产品发布</div>
        <h1 id="hero-title">让收藏<br><em>不止于标记。</em></h1>
        <p class="hero-desc">把地图、影像、旅行攻略与路线，<br>重新组织到每一个地点之下。</p>
        <div class="hero-wordbar"><span>发现</span><i></i><span>收藏</span><i></i><span>记录</span><i></i><span>出发</span></div>

    <section class="page content-page" data-page="origin" aria-labelledby="origin-title">
      <div class="chapter-top"><div class="chapter-number">01 — DESIGN INTENT</div><h2 id="origin-title">为什么从一张地图开始？</h2><p>收藏的意义，不该停留在一个坐标。</p></div>
      <div class="origin-grid">
        <article class="origin-card"><div class="origin-image"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Footprint Map 原版收藏星标与真实地图界面" loading="lazy"></div><div class="origin-caption"><span class="mini-index">01</span><h3>地点，是索引</h3><p>让想去与去过的地方，回到地图上的明确位置。</p></div></article>
        <article class="origin-card"><div class="origin-image"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Footprint Map 真实地点内容与站外攻略界面" loading="lazy"></div><div class="origin-caption"><span class="mini-index">02</span><h3>内容，跟着地点走</h3><p>照片、视频、笔记、站外攻略，不再各自分散。</p></div></article>
        <article class="origin-card"><div class="origin-image"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Footprint Map 原版路线地图与连线界面" loading="lazy"></div><div class="origin-caption"><span class="mini-index">03</span><h3>收藏，也能成为出发</h3><p>把保存下来的地点串成路线，延续下一段旅程。</p></div></article>
      </div>
      <div class="statement"><span class="statement-star">★</span><p>从地点开始，让旅行信息重新连在一起。</p></div>
    </section>

    <section class="page content-page" data-page="map" aria-labelledby="map-title">
      <div class="chapter-top"><div class="chapter-number">02 — MAP & ICONS</div><h2 id="map-title">地图的语言，已经在产品里。</h2><p>单颗黄星、轻量 POI、地图层级与路线连线，都来自现有产品。</p></div>
      <div class="map-stage">
        <div class="map-stage-photo"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="实际 iPhone 上的 Footprint Map 首页地图与黄色收藏星标" loading="lazy"></div>
        <div class="map-stage-notes">
          <div class="note-row"><span class="key-icon"><img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," alt="原版收藏图标"/></span><div><strong>一颗黄星</strong><p>收藏是信息入口，不用重复的浮层和装饰抢占地图。</p></div></div>
          <div class="note-row"><span class="key-icon"><img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," alt="原版地图适配图标"/></span><div><strong>地图优先</strong><p>搜索、选点、浏览与查看，尽可能留在同一张地图里。</p></div></div>
          <div class="note-row"><span class="key-icon"><img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," alt="原版路线图标"/></span><div><strong>路线不离开地图</strong><p>路线点、连线和地理位置始终保持联系。</p></div></div>
          <div class="source-mark">本页示例：真实 V5 录屏 · 产品源文件 SVG</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="icon-block"><div class="icon-header"><div><span class="mini-index">ICON LIBRARY</span><h3>原版图标陈列</h3><p>原始 SVG 文件直接呈现，不重绘、不重新上色。</p></div><div class="icon-count"><strong>60</strong><span>个 SVG 素材<br>含 2 个状态变体</span></div></div>
        <div class="icon-toolbar"><div class="filter-row" role="group" aria-label="图标分类"><button type="button" data-filter="poi" class="active">地点 / POI</button><button type="button" data-filter="ui">操作 / 状态</button><button type="button" data-filter="all">全部图标</button></div><div class="icon-total" id="icon-result-count"></div></div>
        <div class="icon-gallery" id="icon-gallery" aria-live="polite"></div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="page content-page" data-page="system" aria-labelledby="system-title">
      <div class="chapter-top"><div class="chapter-number">03 — VISUAL LANGUAGE</div><h2 id="system-title">视觉不只是一张好看的界面。</h2><p>卡片、控件、状态与间距，应该说同一种设计语言。</p></div>
      <div class="system-top">
        <div class="system-feature"><div class="feature-mosaic"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="真实地点卡片设计"/><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="真实完整地点详情卡片"/></div><div class="small-meta">从地图星标到内容卡片 · 真实产品画面</div></div>
        <div class="token-panel"><div class="token-head"><span class="mini-index">FROM THE PRODUCT CSS</span><h3>可以核对的设计细节</h3></div>
          <div class="token-row"><div><strong>22px</strong><small>地点卡片与搜索面板的主圆角</small></div><div class="round-sample round-big"></div></div>
          <div class="token-row"><div><strong>54px</strong><small>搜索输入区域的最小高度</small></div><div class="dimension-sample">搜索</div></div>
          <div class="token-row"><div><strong>44 × 5px</strong><small>地点卡片顶部滑动抓手</small></div><div class="handle-sample"><span></span></div></div>
          <div class="token-row"><div><strong>14px</strong><small>媒体内容容器 / 部分按钮的圆角</small></div><div class="round-sample round-small"></div></div>

        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="palette-title"><span class="mini-index">COLOR & TYPE</span><h3>让内容成为焦点</h3></div>
      <div class="palette-grid">
        <div class="color-chip"><div class="swatch" style="background:#fffdf9"></div><div><strong>纸白</strong><code>#FFFDF9</code></div></div>
        <div class="color-chip"><div class="swatch" style="background:#222420"></div><div><strong>深色文字</strong><code>#222420</code></div></div>
        <div class="color-chip"><div class="swatch" style="background:#f5f2eb"></div><div><strong>暖灰</strong><code>#F5F2EB</code></div></div>
        <div class="color-chip"><div class="swatch" style="background:#d5a544"></div><div><strong>收藏强调色</strong><code>#D5A544</code></div></div>
        <div class="color-chip"><div class="swatch" style="background:#ebe7df"></div><div><strong>弱分隔</strong><code>#EBE7DF</code></div></div>
      </div>
      <div class="type-sample"><div><span class="mini-index">TYPE HIERARCHY</span><h3>清晰的中文层级</h3></div><div class="type-stack"><strong>收藏这个目的地</strong><span>在同一张地图上组织地点和内容</span><small>需要时提供辅助信息，不让次级文字占据视觉中心</small></div></div>
    </section>

    <section class="page content-page" data-page="content" aria-labelledby="content-title">
      <div class="chapter-top"><div class="chapter-number">04 — PLACE AS A CONTAINER</div><h2 id="content-title">一颗星，装下一个地点的故事。</h2><p>不止收藏坐标，更能保留影像、个人记录和站外旅行内容。</p></div>
      <div class="content-showcase">
        <div class="shot-main"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="真实地点卡片与照片视频内容" loading="lazy"><span class="shot-label">地点详情 / 内容入口</span></div>
        <div class="shot-stack"><div class="shot-minor"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="真实 iOS 相册选择照片和视频界面" loading="lazy"><span class="shot-label">照片与视频</span></div><div class="shot-minor"><img src="data:image/webp;base64,
